items.description: Short drill items, at most `per_idea` for each idea asked about, each made from one of the verses sent.

idea.description: The id of the idea the item drills, copied from the request.

kind.description: tap-form: he taps the word of the verse that is what the prompt names. meaning: he is shown some Greek words of the verse and picks what they say.

ref.description: The verse the item is made from, copied from the request.

prompt.description: What is asked, in one plain line, such as 'Tap the genitive singular noun'.

form.description: A meaning item only: the Greek word or words of the verse, in the verse's order, copied exactly. Left out of a tap-form item.

options.description: Exactly four different choices. A tap-form item's are four words of the verse, copied exactly; a meaning item's are four short English renderings.

right.description: The one right choice, exactly as it is among the options.
